title: Conductor Blueprint Schema v1.1
description: Schema for claude-conductor blueprint.json files — v1.1 adds typed gates[] as a progressive replacement for agents[]. Fully backward-compatible: agents[] remains valid. gates[] is optional; if both present, gates[] takes priority at runtime (with a deprecation warning). NOTE: hub.js enforces only 'name', 'version', 'agents' — all other fields are validated by this schema for IDE support and contributor guidance only.

schema_version.description: Blueprint schema version. Use '1.1.0' for blueprints using gates[]. Absence triggers v1 coercion at runtime. Strongly recommended when using gates[].

description.description: One sentence: what does this blueprint do?

inputs.description: User-provided inputs. Reference in prompts as {{input_name}}

cost_profile.description: Cost estimation. Formula: agents/gates × ~10k tokens × $0.003/1k ≈ cost

allowed_commands.description: Shell commands allowed. NEVER include destructive commands (rm -rf, del, format)

permissions.description: Minimum permissions required. Default to most restrictive.

type.description: Step type. 'agent' (default) = LLM call. 'tool' = deterministic command, no LLM.

prompt.description: For agent steps: instruction. Supports {{input_name}} and {{role.field}} interpolation.

command.description: For tool steps: shell command or built-in tool. Supports {{input_name}} interpolation. Built-ins: conductor://tools/read-file, conductor://tools/validate-schema, conductor://tools/git-status.

timeout_ms.description: For tool steps: max execution time in ms. Default: 5000.

on_failure.description: For tool steps: behavior on non-zero exit. Default: 'abort'.

output_var.description: For tool steps: captures stdout as a named variable. Reference in later steps as {{output_var}}.

count.description: For agent steps: number of parallel instances. Use a number or {{input_name}} for dynamic count.

condition.description: Execute this step only if condition is true. E.g.: 'previous-agent.status == "failure"'

agents.description: LEGACY: Ordered steps inherited from v1. Still valid in v1.1. If gates[] is also present, gates[] takes priority at runtime with a deprecation warning. Prefer gates[] for new blueprints.

gates.description: v1.1 replacement for agents[]. Typed gates with explicit id, richer output validation, and parallel execution control. If both gates[] and agents[] are present, gates[] takes priority (runtime warning emitted). 'skill' type is reserved for Release 3 and not valid in v1.1.

id.description: Gate identifier in kebab-case. Must be unique within the blueprint (uniqueness enforced at runtime, not by schema). Used for cross-gate references: {{gate-id.field}}.

type.description: Gate type. 'agent' = LLM call with a prompt. 'tool' = deterministic command, no LLM. Note: 'skill' type is reserved for Release 3 and is NOT valid in v1.1.

role.description: For agent gates: role name in kebab-case. Identifies the agent persona or capability. Required when type is 'agent'.

prompt.description: For agent gates: LLM instruction. Supports {{input_name}} and {{gate-id.field}} interpolation. Required when type is 'agent'.

ref.description: Optional reference to a named agent or tool definition. Format: 'agents/<name>' or 'tools/<name>'. When present, inherits the referenced definition's defaults.

command.description: For tool gates: shell command or built-in conductor tool. Supports {{input_name}} interpolation. Built-ins: conductor://tools/read-file, conductor://tools/validate-schema, conductor://tools/git-status. Required when type is 'tool'.

output_format.description: Expected output format. 'json' enables output_schema validation and structured cross-gate references. Default: 'text'.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema draft-07 object validating the gate's output. Only evaluated when output_format is 'json'. Example: {"type": "object", "required": ["status"], "properties": {"status": {"type": "string"}}}

timeout_ms.description: Max execution time in milliseconds. Primarily for tool gates. Default: 5000.

condition.description: Execute this gate only if condition evaluates to true. Supports {{gate-id.field}} and {{input_name}} references. E.g.: '{{validator.status}} == "pass"'

parallel.description: Number of parallel instances to spawn for this gate. Only values > 1 are meaningful (1 is the default serial behavior). Each instance receives the same inputs; use {{parallel_index}} within the prompt to differentiate.

exit_condition.description: Concrete, testable condition for loop termination. Must be reachable.

max_rounds.description: Safety cap. Recommended: 1-10. Use {{input_name}} for user-configurable cap.

loop.description: Loop control. Always set max_rounds to prevent infinite loops. Note: 'on_max_rounds' (Release 2) and 'dry_run' (Release 3) are not valid in v1.1.
